studio_plugin_sdk/__init__.py.purpose: Real top-level SDK package (2026-07-16, 010 SDK inversion task 01). Public plugin-facing surface: StudioTTSEngine, TTSRequest/TTSResult/VerificationResult + timing types, errors, plugin_utils. Ships py.typed. SDK_VERSION = "1.0". Does NOT export BaseVoiceEngine/EngineHealthModel/Engine*Error (host-side only, stay in app.*).

exports.name: StudioTTSEngine, TTSRequest, TTSResult, VerificationResult, TimingEvent, SegmentTimingResult, TTSTimingResult, SynthesisPlan, VoiceProcessingHooks, StudioPluginContext, JobSpec, JobResult

notes: resolves via the real top-level package (repo root is sys.path[0] because the watchdog spawns `python -u <BASE_DIR>/tts_server.py`, script-dir semantics) -- no sys.modules alias hack (deleted, see app/tts_server/plugin_loader.py notes)

module identity guaranteed: exactly one studio_plugin_sdk module object; app.engines.voice.sdk / app.engines.voice.base / app.studio_plugin_sdk.* are all thin re-export shims over this package, pinned by tests/engines/test_sdk_module_identity.py

exports.name: TimingEventName, TimingEvent, SegmentTimingResult, TTSTimingResult, TTSRequest, TTSResult, VerificationResult, SynthesisPlan, VoiceProcessingHooks

notes: plugin authors import ONLY from this module, no other app.* imports

exports.name: StudioTTSEngine
exports.contract: abstract SDK contract for plugin engines; run_test(*, asset_search_order=None, default_text=None, settings=None) has a real shared implementation (PL-3) -- omitting asset_search_order preserves the original always-not-implemented VerificationResult

studio_plugin_sdk/context.py.purpose: MOVED from app/studio_plugin_sdk/context.py (2026-07-16, 010 SDK inversion task 01). Plugin SDK context object and job dataclasses; exposes 13 service groups via late imports. Retains ~40 lazy function-body app.* imports (host-implemented context, executes only in the Studio host process) -- the documented exception to the SDK zero-app.* gate, module-level-only for this file.

exports.name: StudioPluginContext
exports.contract: wraps 13 app.* service groups: update_job_progress, emit_segment_started/saved/progress, get_speaker_wavs, build_chunk_groups, generate_via_bridge, get_behavior, is_cancelled, update_segment, run_voice_job, resolve_voice_preview_inputs etc.; group_needs_render(group, pdir, *, force_rerender=False) -> bool (PL-2, 2026-07-04): single shared reuse-gate replacing 3 near-identical _group_needs_render locals (xtts/voxtral bake, mixed handler), standardizes on the stricter validated-artifact check + per-segment DB status

exports.name: MAX_SEGMENT_DURATION_SECONDS, _validated_wav_duration_seconds, _is_valid_segment_artifact
exports.contract: PL-2 (2026-07-04): validated-artifact-metadata gate moved here from tts_engines/tts_mixed/handler.py; exists+non-zero-size, and when parseable as WAV via stdlib wave, header duration must be 0<d<=3600s

notes: all app.* imports late-imported inside wrapper methods to enforce zero side effects on import

2026-07-04 follow-up: standard_handler.py's _group_is_done upgraded to the same validated-artifact standard via a new is_valid_segment_artifact(path) public wrapper around _is_valid_segment_artifact -- closes queue-jobs.md §3.7's residual drift (spec now 1.11.2), no known reuse-gate drift remains across any of the 4 render paths

studio_plugin_sdk/plugin_utils.py.purpose: MOVED from app/studio_plugin_sdk/plugin_utils.py (2026-07-16). Shared plugin-side helpers: PL-1 context factory + PL-3 settings-schema loader + PL-2 segment-marker output handler factory. Now imports .context relatively.

exports.name: get_plugin_ctx
exports.contract: (engine_id) -> StudioPluginContext; one lazy instance per engine_id, cached forever, never shared across engine_ids

exports.name: load_settings_schema
exports.contract: (schema_path, *, engine_name, cache=True) -> dict; reads+parses JSON, returns {} and logs a warning on missing/malformed file (never caches a failure); cache=True (default) caches successful parses forever (xtts's original behavior), cache=False re-reads every call (voxtral's original live-reload behavior) -- the two plugins' pre-merge _load_settings_schema()s were NOT behaviorally identical, this param preserves both exactly

exports.name: make_segment_output_handler
exports.contract: (*, on_output, cancel_check, path_to_group, update_seg, completed_groups, total_groups, update_job_fn, jid, progress_formula, on_group_completed=noop, on_group_started=noop, emit_on_save=True) -> on_output closure; parses [SEGMENT_SAVED]/[START_SEGMENT]/[PROGRESS] markers with the I17 cancel-guard reproduced byte-for-byte; replaces 4 duplicated on_output closures (xtts+voxtral bake/segments). progress_formula is caller-supplied (linear vs weighted) so the shared code never branches on engine_id

notes: extracted from 9 duplicated _get_ctx() lazy-singleton blocks (PL-1) and 2 duplicated _load_settings_schema()s (PL-3), 2026-07-04

tts_mixed/handler.py additionally keeps its own separate _ctx_instance/set_ctx() injection hook (live, called from app/orchestration/tasks/synthesis.py) -- untouched by this factory; harmless because StudioPluginContext is stateless (holds only engine_id)

PL-2 (2026-07-04): make_segment_output_handler added, replacing 4 duplicated on_output closures; two genuine non-formula behavioral differences preserved as explicit params (on_group_completed/on_group_started hooks for xtts's j.* mutations; emit_on_save=False for voxtral segments.py's SEGMENT_SAVED-skips-update_job asymmetry) rather than inferred from engine_id

studio_plugin_sdk/errors.py.purpose: MOVED from app/studio_plugin_sdk/errors.py (2026-07-16); clean SDK error hierarchy -- guarded app.engines.errors import replaced with an SDK-owned exception hierarchy (zero app.* imports now).
notes: BridgeError dual-inherits for compatibility with EngineBridgeError
extracted from duplicate implementations to avoid cross-plugin namespace collisions

studio_plugin_sdk/proc.py.purpose: Generic subprocess-streaming mechanism (moved out of app/engines/proc_utils.py, 2026-07-16, stdlib-only, zero app.* imports)

exports.name: run_cmd_stream
exports.contract: (cmd, on_output, cancel_check, env=None) -- signature unchanged. Note: the scratch_dir param some task docs proposed was NOT added -- run_cmd_stream never used TRANSIENT_DIR; only marker helpers do, and those stayed in app/engines/proc_utils.py.

notes: app-side callers resolve run_cmd_stream via app/engines/proc_utils.py at call time (monkeypatch sites patching app.engines.proc_utils.run_cmd_stream still work)

studio_plugin_sdk/audio.py.purpose: wav_to_mp3 and audio helpers with an injectable runner (moved out of app/engines/audio_ops.py, 2026-07-16)

exports.name: wav_to_mp3
exports.contract: (in_wav, out_mp3, *, quality: int, on_output=None, cancel_check=None, runner=None). runner defaults to studio_plugin_sdk.proc.run_cmd_stream (resolved via module attr at call time); the Studio host injects its own runner via app/engines/audio_ops.py's thin wrapper.

notes: app keeps an app-flavored wrapper (audio_ops.py#wav_to_mp3) injecting MP3_QUALITY + the app-resolved runner
